import Foundation

func work(_ item: Int) async {}
func save(_ item: Int) async {}
func refresh(_ item: Int) async {}

final class Store {
  var items: [Int] = []
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []

  // CASE ret_task_loop expect=fire
  @discardableResult
  func refreshAll() -> Task<Void, Never> {
    Task {
      for item in items {
        await refresh(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE ret_task_loop_if expect=fire
  func refreshSome() -> Task<Void, Never> {
    Task {
      for item in items {
        if item > 0 {
          await refresh(item)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE computed_task_loop expect=fire
  var refresher: Task<Void, Never> {
    Task {
      for item in items {
        await refresh(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_noargs_comment expect=pass
  func start() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(Task<Void, Never> {
        // don't block the caller here
        await work(item)
      })
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_noargs_plain expect=pass
  func startPlain() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(Task<Void, Never> {
        await work(item)
      })
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_noargs_string expect=pass
  func startString() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(Task<Void, Never> {
        print("it's \(item)")
        await work(item)
      })
    }
  }

  // CASE capture_comment expect=pass
  func startCapture() {
    for item in items {
      Task { [weak self] in
        // don't wait here
        await self?.work2(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE ret_generic_args_loop expect=fire
  func refreshArgs() -> Task<Void, Never> {
    Task(priority: .utility) {
      for item in items {
        await refresh(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE async_ret_task expect=fire
  func syncThenStart() async -> Task<Void, Never> {
    for item in items {
      await save(item)
    }
    return Task { await work(0) }
  }

  func work2(_ item: Int) async {}
}
